description: Halbert RAG corpus - Cleaned, schema-normalized, and deduplicated Linux, macOS, BSD, and Common system administration knowledge base

arch_wiki.description: Arch Linux Wiki - comprehensive Linux documentation (hannah-eee dataset and curated extensions)

linux_man_pages.description: Linux man pages - command reference documentation (backspaces stripped, deduped)

tldr_pages.description: TLDR simplified command summaries across Common, Linux, macOS, and BSD platforms

common_tools.description: Cross-platform core tools (git, devtools, shell, python, docker, containers, aws-cli)

linux_system_docs.description: Linux system guides (systemd, networking, security, storage, backup, monitoring, kernel)

vendor_and_distro_docs.description: Vendor and distro documentation (Docker, K8s, Helm, NVIDIA, ROCm, Ubuntu)

macos_homebrew.description: Homebrew package manager documentation - formulas, casks, and official docs

macos_man_pages.description: macOS man pages extracted from local system - command reference (deduped, clean)

macos_support.description: SS64 macOS command reference and synthetic macOS troubleshooting guides (APFS, Apple Silicon, notarization, MDM, recovery, user management, software update, Spotlight, diagnostics)
macos_support.note: SS64 content is CC BY-NC 4.0 - exclude from paid App Store builds. Synthetic guides are Halbert-authored.

macos_ask_different.description: Ask Different (apple.stackexchange.com) high-voted Q&A with accepted answers - macOS troubleshooting, networking, security, hardware

macos_macports_guide.description: MacPorts Guide - package management, portfile development, and project guidelines

freebsd_handbook.description: FreeBSD Handbook - comprehensive BSD documentation covering networking, storage, security, and system administration.

freebsd_man_pages.description: FreeBSD man pages for BSD commands shared with macOS - user commands, system admin, file formats

mac_build_exclusions: All sources with mac_build: false are excluded from paid Mac App Store build
GNU FDL content (Arch Wiki) excluded due to copyleft licensing
See docs/Phase54_licensing-roundup/ for full licensing audit
attribution_requirements: Stack Exchange content requires CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution
TLDR content requires CC BY 4.0 attribution
SS64 content requires CC BY-NC 4.0 attribution (non-commercial only)
FreeBSD Handbook requires FreeBSD Documentation License attribution
macOS man pages: BSD pages require BSD license attribution, Apple pages require APSL 2.0 attribution
